page.name: tiers
page.p: Manage player tiers for this tournament. A DEFAULT tier is created automatically. Add more tiers as needed and assign them to players.

page.name: other_attributes

separator.string: Att-Labels for Player Cards & Excel Upload

page.p: Define the Other Attribute labels for this football tournament (e.g. Club, Experience). They appear as Excel template columns and as Label / Value rows on each player form. When a player has values filled, Secondary / Age / Playing Style / Strengths are replaced by these attributes on cards and live displays.

div.p: Choose how player cards look on auction displays and printed PDFs. Tap a theme card to select it.

field.help: Show or hide the Registration Capacity slab on the public player registration form.

field.name: expose_registered_org_id
field.help: Show Org ID# on the public registered-players popup. Hidden unless Org ID# is collected on the form.

field.name: expose_registered_address
field.help: Show player address on the public registered-players popup so friends can recognise each other.

group.div:
Share the registration link from the Helper Links tab with players so they can fill in their own profile. Registrations arrive as Draft players.
Set Max Registrations to 0 for unlimited. Registration closes automatically once the limit is reached.

On: viewers must enter the Tournament Code once; that browser stays unlocked afterwards.
Off: anyone with the Live Board URL (see Helper Links) can watch without a code (board must still be Live).

field.name: whatsapp_group_link
field.help: Players will see a 'Join WhatsApp Group' button after registering.

div.div: Copy and share the registration URL with players. Optionally add a WhatsApp group invite so players can join after they register.

group.div: Unlock once with the tournament code (). Works even when public registration is closed, until Max Registrations is reached.

div.div: Use this link for organisers to register players themselves. Enter the unique tournament code once on the device, then keep registering until the allotment is full — both public and admin URLs then show squad complete.
Use this link to review and mark player registration payments.
Open this URL on a projector or large screen for the audience. It updates in real-time while operators run display_auction (Random) or player_selector (Manual).
Auction rules required. Set Auction Rules for this tournament before the Projector URL and Player Console become available.
Share this link with outsiders so they can watch the auction live. Turn the board Live from the tournament header first. Code protection is configured under Presentation & Theme.
Live team purse and bid summary dashboard. Share with operators or open on a second screen to track remaining points per team.

div.p: Upload a poster shown on the player registration page sidebar, above the "Why Register?" section.

group.div: Recommended: portrait/square format (e.g. 600 × 800 px). PNG or JPG.

field.placeholder: e.g. Pay ₹500 via UPI to 9876543210@paytm. Add your name as payment reference, then attach the screenshot below.

page.name: advertisers
page.p: Upload sponsor or advertiser images here. They will rotate on the live board footer at all times, appear prominently during Break Time on the auction screen, and show in the Squad Poster (Instagram) footer. Recommended image size: 800 × 300 px (landscape).
